addon.title: Live collaboration (whiteboard)
addon.summary: Lets several people draw on the same Excalidraw board at once. It installs Node.js. Estimate: about 60 MB of storage and 40 MB of memory while in use. Install the relay before you start a shared session.
addon.needs: Set up the relay first. On this page, open Maintenance, then App updates. Select Track app updates. Then select Install.
